meta.name: wechat-article-search-api-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users extract full article contents from WeChat using the BrowserAct API. The Agent should proactively apply this skill when users express needs like finding full WeChat articles for specific keywords, tracking WeChat public accounts for industry trends, extracting WeChat article contents for media research, monitoring public relations on WeChat platforms, collecting competitor updates from WeChat, getting full article body from WeChat links, monitoring brand exposure on WeChat articles, retrieving structured WeChat data for sentiment analysis, summarizing daily news from WeChat, getting author and publication date for WeChat articles, or automating WeChat content extraction without scraping.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从微信公众号提取全文内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从微信公众号批量获取文章全文用于分析或监控。
copy.tagline_en: Extract full articles from WeChat public accounts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch extract full WeChat articles for analysis or monitoring.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据关键词搜索微信公众号文章，并提取完整正文、标题、作者、发布日期等信息。
howto.when: 当用户需要查找特定关键词的微信文章、追踪公众号动态、或提取微信文章内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索微信上关于AI agent的最新文章。
say.note: Claude 会调用技能搜索并返回文章列表。

say.text: 查找2026年3月10日发布的微信文章，关键词是“openclaw”。
say.note: Claude 会按日期和关键词筛选文章。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search WeChat public account articles by keywords and extract full body text, title, author, publication date, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need to find WeChat articles for specific keywords, track public accounts, or extract article content.

say_en.text: Search for the latest WeChat articles about AI agent.
say_en.note: Claude will use the skill to search and return results.

say_en.text: Extract the full content of this WeChat article: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/xxx
say_en.note: Claude will extract the full text from the link.

say_en.text: Find WeChat articles published on March 10, 2026 with keyword 'openclaw'.
say_en.note: Claude will filter by date and keyword.
